purpose: Repair the v2 diffusion, column, dimension, sphere-union and identifiability defects before a correlation-only CF4 x VAST executor is frozen.

counterevidence: VQ05 used the word causal for a parabolic diffusion law and short-circuited D_g=0 to equilibrium
VQ06 documentation did not match endpoint quadrature and self-cell regularization
VQ08 used a thresholded ray surrogate and silently assigned unobserved distance to matter
the absolute two-phase rates were not identifiable separately from the distance trend

VQ05.label: THREE_DIMENSIONAL_PARABOLIC_DYNAMIC_RESERVOIR
VQ05.steady_limit: Only t->infinity, not D_g=0 itself, equals VQ03 equilibrium

VQ06.column_rule: Exactly N equal-length source-target segments sampled at their midpoints with trilinear density interpolation
VQ06.self_kernel: The point-source self kernel is defined by the frozen even-order tensor Gauss-Legendre average over one cubic voxel; the zero-length self column is zero

VQ08.geometry: Analytic observer-ray/sphere intersections clipped to the target segment and exact interval union
VQ08.prediction: residual ln(1+z)=delta_H L_void/c after the ordinary distance trend absorbs H_m L_observed
VQ08.signed_velocity_equivalent: c residual_ln(1+z)=delta_H L_void; positive delta_H means extra redshift and positive velocity residual

response_contract.observed_coordinate: s_obs=ln(1+V3k/c), treating the catalog velocity column as cz
response_contract.baseline: s_FLRW(D_L) from the same frozen flat Planck2018 luminosity-distance inversion plus frozen nuisance flow

split_contract.canonical_bytes: ASCII decimal digits of positive integer 1PGC, with no sign, whitespace or leading zeros
split_contract.bucket: unsigned big-endian integer represented by digest bytes[0:8], modulo 10
